title: Compile gates need summarized success/failure output
wanted_capability: A first-class compile gate surface that runs a build command, checks exit code, and returns bounded success/failure plus relevant error lines without flooding the isolate transcript with build-system noise.
fallback_used: Used shell_run with max_output_tokens and inferred success from exit_code.
notes: DeepSeek reported Gradle output around hundreds of KB during compile gates; the exit code was the meaningful signal.
